testcase.name: blockers sort above information and the order is stable()
a briefing with nothing to say contributes no line()
an empty queue and an unreachable gateway never say the same thing()
a malformed row does not take the whole queue down()
informational items alone do not read as something waiting()
blockers are counted and informational items are not()
an item with no title is labelled rather than shown blank()
one waiting item reads as one, not as a number()
the briefing falls back to its summary when it has no headline()
a failure carries its reason to the owner()
